orderingModel.description: Mechanism the host uses to derive the total order. `lamport` = Lamport timestamps on each append. `vector-clock` = per-engine vector counters merged at read. `global-sequencer` = single sequencer assigns monotonic seq numbers (the Postgres reference host's posture).
